blocks.html: Christmas day is drawing near and the holiday rush intensifies with bumper-to-bumper traffic and long queue in stores – thanks to Robinsons Malls’ MallDash.ph, no single shopper will be left scramming for Christmas finds!

Christmas time is not complete without the monito monita, a Filipino tradition of gift-giving. While gifting can be quite a challenge, Robinsons Malls gives its shoppers new and more convenient ways to shop, creating more avenues for customers to find that perfect holiday present.

Everything is easy with MallDash, the hyperlocal online shopping platform of Robinsons Malls where you can find and choose various items – from groceries, food, drinks, apparel, gadgets and other essentials in just one go! You just have to visit MallDash.ph, select your preferred mall – Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Place Ilocos, Robinsons Magnolia, or Robinsons Place Las Pinas- and scan through its multiple stores to find what you need. You may opt to have your orders delivered immediately within an hour or schedule for later. What’s better is that this December until January 7, 2022, MallDash.ph shoppers can avail free delivery within 8 km from Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Place Ilocos, Robinsons Magnolia, and 6 km from Robinsons Place Las Pinas.

Planning to splurge on a new mobile phone or gadget? Worried about an item’s authenticity and secure delivery? MallDash’s Pabili service got you covered! Just upload a photo and details of the gadget on the Pabili section of MallDash.ph, and a MallDash Picker will swiftly assist you with your intended purchase – a guaranteed safe and secure transaction. Plus, customers can get an additional 20% off and a free same-day delivery.
If you are on a budget, MallDash has discount voucher codes for you. Use these codes to buy anything you need from the mall and save on time and cash.
MERRYMALLDASH50 – Less P50 and free same-day delivery. Minimum spend of P250.
MERRYMALLDASH100 – Less P100 and free same-day delivery. Minimum spend of P500
GIFTAGADGET – Less 20% on any tech or mobile gadget. No minimum spend required. Discount capped at P500.

Mall Dash makes the holidays merry- not scary- with all its discount offerings and safe and secured transaction. Visit https://tinyurl.com/MerryMallDash and follow @MallDashPH on Facebook to discover more. ###
